title: Spatial resolution and aggregation candidates for July 2024
footprint_limitation: scan and track are stored lengths in kilometres. Their product treats those lengths as the sides of a rectangle. The archive does not include the pixel polygon, the scan angle, or the ground orientation. Adjacent-scan overlap and Earth curvature inside the pixel are not corrected. scan multiplied by track is a stored-size proxy, not an exact physical pixel area.
